playbook.note: Existing Japanese translations keep even the common noun in English with a capital P (Playbook名, Playbookを実行する). Do not use プレイブック.

run.note: Noun (a run): 実行. Verb (run a playbook): Playbookを実行する. Rerun: 再実行. 実行 is used for both singular and plural.

finish a run.note: Finished (state): 完了; Run finished: 実行完了.

resume a run.note: No existing translation for Resume/Restart strings; 再開する fits the 'reopen a finished run' meaning. Related existing term: 再実行 (Rerun).

status update.note: In Playbooks, ステータス refers to run progress, not user availability. Post update: ステータスの更新を投稿する.

owner.note: Make run owner: 実行のオーナーにする.

action.note: Channel Actions: チャンネルアクション; Task actions: タスクアクション. Note existing 'Run Actions' → アクションの実行 is a mistranslation (should be 実行アクション); prefer 実行アクション for new strings.

metric.note: メトリクス is used for both singular and plural in existing translations.

overdue.note: Majority rendering; one string uses 期限超過. Prefer 期限切れ.

due date.note: No due date: 期限なし.

stakeholder.note: Existing usage mixes ステークホルダー and 関係者; prefer ステークホルダー as the glossary term, 関係者 acceptable in flowing prose.

invitation.note: Invite participants: 参加者を招待する; Disable invitation: 招待を無効にする.

run channel.note: No direct existing translation; composed from 実行 (run) + チャンネル (channel), consistent with 実行タイムライン (run timeline).

broadcast.note: Existing: 選択したチャンネルに更新内容を配信する (Broadcast update to selected channels).

condition.note: No existing translation (new feature); 条件 is the standard term. Add condition: 条件を追加.

section.note: No existing translation (new feature); standard katakana loanword. Section name: セクション名.

run summary.note: Existing: 実行概要を追加 (Add a run summary), 実行概要テンプレート. Standalone Summary: 概要.
